dispositions.basis: Retained form state is null and saves global configuration; a distinct created record with stable identity and matched create/update lifecycle is not established.

Only name is established as independently editable scalar text. Essential engine/property implementations are outside the frozen tree; project.deps names dbeaver without a revision, server parent is sibling 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT, AI bundle has unversioned model.ai dependency, and the build clones dbeaver/dbeaver-common/datadam-api without refs. Engine-dependent local-only discovery and the second scalar cannot be established without expanding dependency acquisition beyond the registered mapping.
dispositions.not_claimed: Not an application defect, universal incompatibility or proof all engines require remote services.
